accepted_items.title: Creation of the Gods I: Kingdom of Storms

rejection_summary: Painted Skin: The Resurrection — romance is structurally prominent and available evidence did not support a complete high-confidence live DNA vector above the acceptance threshold.
League of Gods — researched as a mythic action-fantasy candidate, but weak narrative/worldbuilding execution and inconsistent presentation evidence did not support acceptance under the live profile.

L.O.R.D.: Legend of Ravaging Dynasties — strong magic/action premise, but contemporary reviews describe game-like presentation and weak execution; evidence was insufficient to justify an accepted complete vector.
